headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs, winning 17-1 behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' charge at the plate, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 4 RBIs. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win, and the New York Yankees took down the Minnesota Twins 5-2 behind Gerrit Cole's 5.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Freddy Fermin, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion, and Julio Rodríguez, who is out with a concussion. The Seattle Mariners have also placed Cooper Criswell on the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-hander Tom Cosgrove, acquired in a trade with the Houston Astros.

The Washington Nationals have also made another trade, acquiring right-hander Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded right-hander Ben Hansen to the Boston Red Sox for third baseman Brett Harris, and the Texas Rangers traded catcher Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for right-hander Ben Peoples.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Pirates 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Twins 5-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after pitching 5.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Out Reds in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Freddy Fermin on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Freddy Fermin, catcher for the San Diego Padres, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. The move was made on July 3, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher Tom Cosgrove**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-hander Tom Cosgrove, acquired in a trade with the Houston Astros for cash.
